about_the_game:
Embark on a captivating journey in Fuse—a story-driven adventure that blends action, stealth, and puzzle-solving in a unique gameplay experience. Seamlessly shift between two distinct characters, each offering their own specialized abilities. Master the art of stealth with one, navigating complex environments and avoiding detection, while the other excels in precise, fluid platforming challenges. Combine their powers to form a high-paced melee combatant capable of devastating attacks and dynamic movement. As you progress through the game, you'll confront enemies, overcome environmental obstacles, and solve clever puzzles that gradually reveal pieces of a mysterious, emotionally resonant narrative. Explore two intricately designed levels packed with layered platforming, fast-paced combat, and brain-teasing puzzles that test your reflexes and your wit. Dive deeper into the lore behind the characters and the world they inhabit as you unravel the secrets of the past. Fuse invites you to challenge yourself and discover a story worth remembering.

Key features:

  • 3D platforming

  • Puzzles

  • Unique world

  • Cozy experience

  • Unique characters

  • 2 levels

Achievements:

  • Nominated for SGA 2025: Best Audio

  • Nominated for SGA 2025: Best Visuals

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64bit) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 6600 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1050ti or equivalent
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64bit) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 12600 or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1080ti or equivalent
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

short_description: A cozy, 3D, puzzle platformer with a underlying story. Play as cute origami characters exploring a vast world through puzzles, combat and platforming. Fight your way past enemies and rid the world of the black tar.
